quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange with black lettering. Detour signs tell drivers to take an alternate route around a blocked road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn you to be careful. This sign tells you that construction is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a sharp turn coming and tells you to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the center lane is for left turns only. Both directions may use it to turn left. Do not use the center lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.
This is a no passing zone.
Take a detour around dangerous conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour around dangerous conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the traffic pattern ahead is changing due to work. Follow the detour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: A driver extends their left arm downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended downward signals that the driver is stopping. Be ready to slow down or stop if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crossing ahead. Drive with caution where people may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Move to another lane to make room for traffic to enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane to make room for traffic to enter.
questions.explanation: Make space for merging vehicles. If possible and safe, change lanes to let them enter.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may cross the road or ride next to traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the shoulder ahead is lower than the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: From the center lane, what can you do?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane for left turns only from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
A curve is ahead. Slow to 35 mph or less.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. Slow to 35 mph or less.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead. The sign recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians may cross the road ahead.
Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians may cross the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road gets narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road gets narrower ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and let other traffic pass. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the median or divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you that lanes are moving. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane will end. Traffic must move into the left lane.

questions.question: From top to bottom, traffic lights are in this order:
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is on top and green is on the bottom. On horizontal traffic lights, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road is especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to avoid blocking the intersection. It will be posted near an intersection where traffic must flow freely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign directs drivers around roadwork. It tells drivers to follow an alternate route because the normal road is closed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. It alerts drivers that a steep hill is ahead. Adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal says it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells drivers that a school zone is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop at the intersection. Check that it is safe, then you may go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right on a red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to drive in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: When an "Exit only" sign is above your lane, that lane will become an exit ramp. You can change lanes to continue, or you must exit if you stay in that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful in construction zones. This sign tells you that the right lane will be closed ahead due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed to exit a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you about schools nearby. Be alert for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign marks a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully through work zones.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Stay alert for children when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange highway signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you a work crew is on or near the road. Drive very carefully and slowly.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane use control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road hazards. This sign alerts you to a bridge with narrow lanes ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for trains. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An intersection is coming up ahead. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: From this lane, you may turn left or go straight ahead at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic only moves in one direction on this street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Stay alert and be ready to stop. A hazard or obstacle may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: A hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yield sign is coming up. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: From this lane, you may turn right or go straight ahead at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It warns you that a T intersection is ahead. You should be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully on gravel roads because your tires will not grip the road as well.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It has a red circle with a red slash through it. This means the action shown is not allowed. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is diamond-shaped with a yellow background and black markings. It warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because it may become slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: These chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves left. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It warns you to watch for buggies ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. You must obey any instructions from a crossing guard.

questions.question: The driver's left arm is extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is extended upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you are following this driver, adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It means you must follow the law shown. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may become slippery when wet. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around immediately and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill coming up. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that cattle may cross the road ahead. Watch for animals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a fire station nearby. Be alert for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead will become divided.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You may slow down if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start reducing your speed. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. They are controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a traffic signal ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
Certain turns are allowed only from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers may use this lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may scrape or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
You must turn in the direction the arrow points.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must follow the rules on all regulatory signs. Where this sign is posted, passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign controls traffic movement and speed. It means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let other traffic go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the car ahead of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that farm machinery may be on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal driving route. Expect to follow a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is coming from the left.
Right lane ends ahead. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. You must merge into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The bridge or overpass ahead is low.
Two lanes of traffic going in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge or overpass ahead is low.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A worker is ahead directing traffic.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you the parking rules. You can park here for a maximum of two hours during the times shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in this work zone.
A worker is ahead directing traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fines are doubled in this work zone.
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous. Orange signs warn you about construction ahead. This sign tells you that if you break traffic laws in a work zone, your fine will be doubled.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay on the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and traffic.
Slow down but do not stop completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Check for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait until it is safe to go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An extra lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: An extra lane is being added.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of upcoming road hazards. This sign alerts you that an extra lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing here. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Community volunteers are picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the roadway in the area ahead. Drive carefully and watch for workers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows that there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells drivers that traffic is coming from both directions. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells left-turning drivers that they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows the minimum speed you must drive. Do not drive slower than the speed shown.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has several curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to an upcoming curve in the road. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You could damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead and will give you directions. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must travel at exactly this speed.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the maximum legal speed. In rain, snow, ice, or bad conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is not allowed at any time. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering. They warn you about hazards ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you the road ahead is being maintained. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there are three or more curves ahead on the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means large trucks are not allowed where it is posted. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first. You only need to stop if other vehicles are coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left on a green light, but you must let oncoming traffic pass first. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign says you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a reserved parking space. Only vehicles with a handicap permit or license plate can park there.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: These signs warn you about objects or areas that may be dangerous. Avoid them and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down and get ready to stop. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You may stop completely if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the upcoming bridge is narrow. Be careful, especially if you need to pass a truck.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that the road ahead has curves. It curves right first, then left. Slow down and stay alert.
